listing.name: Pokémon Crystal (Gen1Recomp / G1R Deluxe)
listing.summary: An in-development Pokémon Crystal route in Gen1Recomp/G1R Deluxe. Import your own canonical US English Crystal ROM using the project’s instructions; its README lists accepted revisions and SHA-1 values. The shared engine documents Windows x64, Linux x64 and Intel/Apple Silicon macOS, but current package compatibility with Crystal remains unconfirmed. Pokémon Red’s separate qualification does not establish support for this game or managed updates/saves. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
